nodes.name: Recorder - conversation analyzed
nodes.notes: Point your recorder's 'conversation analyzed' webhook here. The payload should carry the call id and the account (and CSM/owner).

nodes.name: Recorder - fetch call
nodes.notes: Fetch the analyzed call (transcript + participants). No Gong? Swap for your recorder's API, or ingest the export via the gtmsi adapters. If no transcript, stop.

nodes.name: Recorder - account history (60d)
nodes.notes: Pull the same account's recent calls to build the last-30d vs prior-30d engagement baseline.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: SELECT Id, Name, Owner.Name, AnnualRevenue, Renewal_Date__c FROM Account WHERE Id = '<RESOLVED_ACCOUNT_ID>'

nodes.name: CRM - account metadata
nodes.notes: Enrich the alert with account metadata (owner/CSM, contract value, renewal date, open cases). Read-only.

nodes.name: Claude - evaluate risk, rate severity, draft alert
Alert only if risk present
nodes.notes: Gate: post only when the model returns an alert (not NO_RISK). Mirrors the spec's 'alert only when a risk is present' rule.

nodes.name: Slack - post risk alert
nodes.notes: Post to the account-risk / CS-alerts channel only on the true branch.

main.node: Claude - evaluate risk, rate severity, draft alert
